feasibility_reason: Only the 2 H8-S alcove zones are drive-validated NOW, and both are collinear (secondary axis). Every distinct-room and angular-branch zone is UNVALIDATED. One decision frame per zone was drafted, so the current candidate set yields far fewer than train>=12/val>=4/test>=6 distinct frames. Reaching the target requires (a) render+drive validation of >=3-4 genuinely distinct rooms incl. a true junction, and (b) authoring multiple decision frames per validated zone. Per H8-M acceptance, collection must NOT proceed until that scale and the embedding distinctness gate are met.
